rows.grounds: compound of pūrṇa, abhiṣeka, and hīna; genitive plural adjective modifying paśūnām
nominative singular noun naming the prescribed practice

items.question: What practice is prescribed for paśu practitioners who lack full abhiṣeka?
premises: paśus lacking full abhiṣeka are addressed
japa is the prescribed practice for them
items.inference: For paśus without full abhiṣeka, japa alone is enjoined.
uncertainties: whether ca adds another practice or merely connects clauses
exact scope of pūrṇābhiṣeka in this context
items.plain_english: For beasts lacking full abhiṣeka, japa alone is prescribed.
